lines.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to {arena}! It is fight night!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We are live from {arena}, and this place is packed to the rafters!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Folks, I have been waiting all week for this one. Let's go to work.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Two armies, one floor, and nowhere to hide. Here we go!

lines.speaker: caller

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: {count} vehicles on the floor tonight, and every one of them came to fight.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: If you're just tuning in, you picked the right night. Green and Rust, live, right now!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Oh, you can feel it in the building tonight. You can feel it!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It's a full house here at {arena}, and they came to see a fight!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Buckle up, folks. This one has all the makings of something special.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: And the control point is live tonight, so nobody gets to sit back and wait!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Welcome to the Scrapyard, where there is cover everywhere and nowhere safe to stand!

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Good evening, and welcome to {arena}. Tonight's match is being broadcast in forty-one districts, and is required viewing in six of them.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Good evening. On behalf of the Syndicate, welcome to {arena}. Please take a moment to locate the exit nearest your seat. Exits will open after the match.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Good evening. Conditions on the floor are excellent tonight. Humidity is low, and the medical team has been asked not to intervene.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Good evening, and thank you for joining us. Tonight's crews have completed their paperwork, and their families have been sent the broadcast schedule.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Welcome to {arena}. Tonight's event is suitable for the whole family, and attendance is optional for children under twelve.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Good evening. Before we begin, the Syndicate would like to thank the district of Low Harbor for tonight's participants.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Welcome, everyone, to {arena}. Concessions are open on the upper concourse, and water is available to ticket holders in the first ten rows.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: A warm welcome to {arena}, to everyone watching at home, and to our viewers in the detention blocks.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Good evening. Tonight's match will be played to elimination. The first three rows have been reinforced since last season.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Welcome to {arena}. Tonight's match includes a control point at the center of the floor. Participants have been informed of its location.
